clips.title: The story
paras: Baros Alexston is the Chief Architect of Stormwind City, stationed within the City Hall overlooking Cathedral Square. A former member of the Stonemasons Guild who helped rebuild the capital after the First War, he chose to accept an official post rather than follow his old friend Edwin VanCleef into open rebellion.

Baros grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in the rolling grasslands of Westfall. During his youth, thieves overran and torched his family's homestead, forcing his father to hurriedly stash their most cherished heirlooms across the grounds before fleeing. Baros eventually journeyed to the capital and joined the Stonemasons Guild, dedicating years of grueling labor alongside Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef to raise Stormwind anew from the ashes of the First War.
